database.load_data module

load_data.py Takes cleaned applicant data and loads it into a PostgreSQL database. Run directly (python load_data.py [file.json]) to load a file; load_data can also be imported and called on its own.

exception database.load_data.InvalidResult[source]

Bases: Exception

Raised when a result is missing required fields or has an invalid structure.

database.load_data.load_data(filepath, database_url: str)[source]

Load applicant results from a JSON file into the applicants table. Results missing required fields are skipped and reported. A result whose url already exists in the table is upserted rather than skipped, so a file that adds optional fields not present in an earlier load (such as the llm_generated fields) fills them in on the existing row instead of being ignored. Implausible gpa/gre/gre_v/ gre_aw values, whether from this file or already in the table from an earlier load, are cleared to NULL rather than left to skew analysis, and any us_or_international value that isn’t ‘American’ or ‘International’ is normalized to ‘Other’, in this file and in the table already.

Parameters:

  • filepath (str or pathlib.Path) – Path to the JSON results file to load.

  • database_url (str) – A “postgresql://user:password@host:port/dbname” connection string.

Returns:

True if the file was read and the database reached (even if some individual results were skipped as invalid), or False if the file couldn’t be read or the database couldn’t be reached at all - callers (the CLI entry point, the Pull Data upload step) use this to tell an unsuccessful load apart from a completed one.

Return type:

bool
